source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: After battle round one, during your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you may select a friendly **NECRONS INFANTRY** unit from the battlefield or **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**. If on the battlefield, remove it and put it into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**. When it arrives from **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**, place it wholly within 6″ of the Monolith and farther than 8″ from every enemy unit. This applies even inside the enemy deployment zone. The arriving unit is barred from **[Charge moves](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** that turn.

detail.timing: own Movement phase, excluding battle round one
detail.ifOnBattlefield: remove unit and put into Strategic Reserves
